```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Habit;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class HabitController extends Controller
{
    // Index method to retrieve all habits
    public function index()
    {
        return Habit::all();
    }

    // Store method to create a new habit
    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $habit = Habit::create($request->all());
        return response()->json($habit, 201);
    }

    // Show method to retrieve a specific habit by ID
    public function show(Habit $habit)
    {
        return response()->json($habit);
    }

    // Update method to modify an existing habit
    public function update(Request $request, Habit $habit)
    {
        $habit->update($request->all());
        return response()->json($habit, 200);
    }

    // Destroy method to delete a specific habit by ID
    public function destroy(Habit $habit)
    {
        $habit->delete();
        return response()->json(['message' => 'Habit deleted'], 204);
    }
}
```
